description: Change the user's timetable and homework in DayHeart. add_class adds a class once, every week or every other week until a date. add_homework adds homework on a new line of a class's homework (the same text is not added twice). set_homework replaces it with a short line (what and for when) and optional details; clear_homework removes it. close_subject marks a subject closed with its result; reopen_subject opens it again. archive_subject hides a subject with all its kinds of classes, as "Archive subject" in the app (in a shared place only its owner can); restore_subject brings it back. post_announcement adds a short announcement to a subject (what the teacher said: dates, credit format, where to hand in) with its source; pin_announcement pins or unpins it (in a shared place only its owner); remove_announcement removes one. add_material attaches a link to a class (class_id) or to the whole subject (subject): DayHeart keeps links, not files, so put the file on the user's cloud drive first and attach its link; remove_material removes one (material_id or url). With source_key (for example tg:<chat>:<message>) homework from the same source goes to the same class and is not added twice. In a shared group timetable the whole group sees classes, homework, materials and announcements, so add them there once the user agreed; a closed subject is the user's own mark.

announcement_id.description: For pin_announcement and remove_announcement: id of the announcement, as listed with the subject

class_id.description: id of the class, for homework or a material of this class

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the (first) day of a new class, or the day of the class the homework is for

details.description: For set_homework: everything else about the homework, up to 4000 characters

end.description: HH:MM, 24-hour: end of a new class

folder.description: For add_material: folder inside the subject's materials, e.g. "Tests" (empty: no folder); for a link that is already there, moves it

grade.description: For close_subject with a grade: the grade as the user says it, up to 12 characters

kind.description: For add_class: kind of class — lecture, practice, lab or seminar. For add_material: guide, template, task (an assignment), notes, slides or sheet

material_id.description: For remove_material: id of the material, as listed with the class or subject

pinned.description: For post_announcement and pin_announcement: pinned on top of the subject

place.description: Place of study (group) name; needed only when the user has several

repeat.description: once (default), weekly or biweekly, for a new class

result.description: For close_subject: passed as a credit, with a grade, or without a result

room.description: Room or building, as the user writes it

source.description: For add_material and post_announcement: where it came from, up to 60 characters, e.g. "group chat", "Moodle", "teacher"

source_key.description: For add_homework and set_homework: id of the source the homework came from, e.g. tg:<chat>:<message> or moodle:<id>

start.description: HH:MM, 24-hour: start of a new class

subject.description: Subject as in the timetable, e.g. "Anatomy (Pr)": the class to add, the class for homework when there is no class_id, the subject to close or reopen, or the subject a material belongs to

text.description: Homework: the text to add (up to 1000 characters), or for set_homework the short line, what and for when (up to 300); for post_announcement — the announcement, up to 300

title.description: For add_material: name to show, up to 120 characters, e.g. "Lecture 3.docx"

until.description: YYYY-MM-DD: last day for weekly or biweekly; at most 90 classes

url.description: For add_material: https link to the file or page (for example a Google Drive file). In a shared place of study the whole group opens it, so the file must be viewable by anyone with the link; the answer says access "closed" if it is not. For remove_material: the link to remove

name: change_study
title: Change classes and homework
